edges.condition: has(hop.route) && hop.route == 'brain' && has(hop.iter) && int(hop.iter) < 12 && has(context.consult_class) && context.consult_class == 'lookup'

description.purpose: Scope marker of the cogny composite: the agent core as ONE hive - the proven tool-loop core (collector fan-in, dispatcher fan-out, a thinking brain) behind ONE consult ingress and ONE advice exit. Its own seam, its own iteration bound, its own restore_ttl. Since 1.1.0 the seam has TWO lanes (GH #124): the same assembled errand goes to ./brain or to ./brain_fast, decided by context.consult_class, so a lookup never queues behind a research answer in one serial mailbox. No keeper, no summarizer, no proxy: the core has no channel, no sessions and no night, so nothing here mints an id or closes a day.
description.use_when: One per agent, never one per channel voice. Instantiate it as a SIBLING of the talkies and wire the two advisor ports plus the tool lanes in the same mutation; the composite is an island until an edge crosses into it. The lookup lane needs nothing extra to exist - it needs the ingress edge of the second tool name to set context.consult_class, and without that every errand takes the deep lane exactly as before.
description.not_in_scope: No tool cells (they are wired per instance on hop.tool_name), no memory hive, no channel surface, no session lifecycle. The core's identity, instructions and tool schemas live in the brains' own cell.db - the composite carries the topology, never the persona; the ONE exception is the `brevity` system slot of ./brain_fast, which is the lane's length discipline and therefore topology. The class is not decided here either: an edge outside this hive reads the tool name the asking model chose.
